Top Solar Company in Malaysia – Solar Experts Powering a Sustainable Future
===========================================================================

**Solarvest** is **Malaysia’s leading**, largest, and **award-winning integrated solar provider**, with over **14 years of expertise** and a strong track record. As a trusted **solar company in Malaysia**, we have developed more than **3,900MW** of ongoing and completed projects across **8 countries in the Asia Pacific region**

Recognized as a top-tier **solar company**, Solarvest continues to drive the growth of **solar Malaysia**, delivering innovative and reliable **solar** energy solutions that power businesses, communities, and a sustainable future.

[Get Started](/products-services/)

Why Choose a Trusted Solar Company in Malaysia
----------------------------------------------

Choosing the right **solar company in Malaysia** is crucial for long-term energy efficiency, cost savings, and system reliability. As a trusted name in the industry, Solarvest brings over a decade of experience delivering high-quality **solar solutions** tailored to the Malaysian climate, regulatory requirements, and business needs. Our track record and commitment to customer satisfaction set us apart as a reliable **solar company** for both commercial and residential clients.

Complete Solar Solutions for Residential, Commercial & Utility
--------------------------------------------------------------

Solarvest offers end-to-end **solar solutions** that cover every stage — from consultation and system design to [**solar panel**](https://solarvest.com/products-services/residential-solar/) installation, monitoring, and maintenance. Whether you’re powering a home, a business, or a large-scale solar farm, our integrated approach ensures seamless delivery. As a full-service **solar company in Malaysia**, we provide solutions that maximize efficiency, reduce energy bills, and contribute to a greener future.

Driving Clean Energy Growth Across Solar Malaysia
-------------------------------------------------

As **solar Malaysia** continues to grow in demand and innovation, Solarvest remains at the forefront by enabling accessible, scalable, and reliable clean energy. We actively contribute to the nation’s renewable energy goals by developing both rooftop and utility-scale solar projects. Our team is committed to advancing **solar** adoption in Malaysia through education, smart financing options, and sustainable technology.

Proven Track Record in Large-Scale Solar Projects
-------------------------------------------------

With over **2,000MW** of ongoing and completed projects, Solarvest is a proven leader in **large-scale** [**solar farm**](https://solarvest.com/products-services/large-scale-solar/) **development**. From LSSPV farms to commercial solar systems, our engineering expertise and industry recognition make us a top choice among **solar companies in Malaysia**. We were also the first company to achieve COD under Malaysia’s inaugural LSS programme, proving our commitment to execution and excellence.

Powering a Sustainable Future with Smart Solar Solutions
--------------------------------------------------------

Our mission goes beyond just installing panels — we aim to power a cleaner, smarter, and more sustainable future. Through smart solar technologies and data-driven performance optimization, Solarvest empowers homes and businesses to transition toward renewable energy. As a leading **solar company**, we make it easy for Malaysians to adopt **solar** and reduce their carbon footprint without compromising performance.

About
-----

Our core business is installing solar PV systems for residential, commercial and industrial, large-scale solar farms, and government organisations. We distribute and install solar and energy-efficient products to hundreds of companies across Asia-Pacific.

Solarvest specialises in other clean energy solutions such as B2B EV mobility, renewable energy certificates and many more. We are proud to be listed on the Main Market of Bursa Malaysia since 2019.

[Learn More](/about-us)

Did You Know?
-------------

Solarvest has installed over 1,000,000+ solar panels, equivalent to 1,600+ football fields. All this is backed by comprehensive warranties and after-sales support, this provides you with the peace of mind you’ll get from dealing with Malaysia’s leading and largest solar provider.

![Solarvest team doing maintenance in a Large Scale Solar farm](https://solarvest.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/Did-you-know-home_img.jpg "Solarvest team doing maintenance in a Large Scale Solar farm")

![One Stop Solutions](https://solarvest.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/one-icon.svg)

### One Stop Solutions

We provide A-Z services catering to every project’s needs, whether big or small, with flexible and dynamic financing options to make clean energy inclusive to all.

![Trusted Global Partner](https://solarvest.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/global-icon.svg)

### Trusted Global Partner

#1 rooftop solar provider in Malaysia by volume. We are committed to sustainable energy and helping our customers benefit from this transition.

![Comprehensive O&M Solutions](https://solarvest.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/comprehensive-icon.svg)

### Comprehensive O&M Solutions

With operations in most states and over 300+ staff, we are customer-centric and committed to after-sales support.

![Certified & Licensed](https://solarvest.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/cert-icon.svg)

### Certified & Licensed

Our installers are trained to the highest standards, to ensure the safety and effectiveness of every system we deliver. We are an internationally recognised ISO and a certified solutions provider by SEDA, ISPQ, and GCPV.

![Design For Durability](https://solarvest.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/durability-icon.svg)

### Design For Durability

We only use Tier 1 world-leading inverters and high efficiency solar panels. Every project is tailored professionally to maximise energy efficiency and cost savings.

![10+ Years of Experience](https://solarvest.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/years-icon.svg)

### 10+ Years of Experience

With over 1,000,000+ solar panels installed in on-going and completed projects and 10+ years experience, this achievement distinguishes us from the other industry players.

What Does  Solarvest Do?
------------------------

Solarvest is a leading clean energy expert with a multi-national presence across in eight Asia-Pacific countries. Originating in Malaysia, the company started as a one-stop solar photovoltaic (PV) system solution provider for residential, commercial, industrial, and utility-scale solar farms cementing its reputation as a top solar company in Malaysia trusted by businesses and government agencies alike.

Solarvest has developed a renewable energy portfolio exceeding 2,000MW, encompassing ongoing and completed projects. Solarvest is currently venturing into offering a wide range of clean energy solutions such as energy efficiency (EE), renewable energy certificates (REC), battery energy storage systems (BESS), low-carbon mobility, green hydrogen, green data centers, and other renewable energy initiatives.

Solarvest is listed on the Main Market of Bursa Malaysia, and operates in the Philippines, Taiwan, Indonesia, Vietnam, Singapore, and Thailand.

![](https://solarvest.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/Mission_img.jpg "Mission_img")

What We Do
----------

Solarvest is a leading clean energy expert with a vision to energising a regenerative world. Since its establishment in 2012, Solarvest has been advocating for solar energy adoption and later embarked on a strategic roadmap to offers more clean energy solutions.

This roadmap includes energy efficiency (EE), renewable energy certificate (REC), battery energy storage system (BESS), electric vehicle (EV) ecosystem solutions, and other clean energy solutions.

With a regional presence in the Philippines, Taiwan, Indonesia, Vietnam, Singapore, Brunei and Thailand, Solarvest is well-positioned in becoming a leading clean energy specialist in the APAC region.

What is Large  Scale Solar?
---------------------------

**Large scale solar**, known as **LSS**, **utility scale solar**, or **solar farm**, is a solar photovoltaic (PV) power plant at a scale large enough to be classified as “utility-scale”. These solar plants are usually designed with an installed capacity of 10 megawatts and above. Through the solar power plant, you can harness the power of the sun to generate clean electricity and supply it to the national grid.

In the context of **solar farm Malaysia** development, these large-scale solar PV projects play a crucial role in supporting the nation’s renewable energy targets and reducing reliance on fossil fuels.

The **Large Scale Solar Photovoltaic (LSSPV) Programme** is a government-led competitive bidding scheme that allows plant owners to generate solar energy via **large scale solar farms in Malaysia** and sell it to the grid up to 25 years. The LSSPV Programme is managed and administered by the **[Energy Commission Malaysia](https://www.st.gov.my/)**. The primary objective is to drive down the Levelized Cost of Energy (LCOE), making clean energy more accessible and cost-effective across the country.

To participate in this programme, potential developers must undergo a competitive bidding process. A comprehensive technical study must be conducted before submitting the scheme to the relevant authority. As **solar farm Malaysia** projects grow in popularity, careful planning and compliance with regulatory guidelines are essential for success.

Corporate Green Power Programme
-------------------------------

[Corporate Green Power Programme (CGPP)](https://www.singlebuyer.com.my/files/Guide_CGPP-_Version_November_2023.pdf) is a renewable energy initiative that enables corporate consumers (CC) to virtually purchase solar energy from solar power producers (SPP) through a virtual power purchase agreement (VPPA).

By participating in this programme, businesses can enjoy the benefits of solar energy without installing solar assets on their properties, as there is no physical transfer of electricity. This programme not only supports the growing number of electricity consumers aiming to achieve their Environment, Social and Governance (ESG) targets, but also provide businesses the opportunity to adopt clean energy within their business operations.

How CGPP Works?
---------------

![How Corporate Green Power Programme (CGPP) works](https://solarvest.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/CGPP-Works-img-scaled.jpg "How Corporate Green Power Programme (CGPP) works")

Under CGPP, the Corporate Consumer (CC) agrees to purchase energy generated by the Solar Power Producer (SPP) at an agreed price. If the actual System Marginal price (SMP) exceeds the agreed price, the SPP compensates the CC for the difference, and vice versa.

design.summary: The desktop homepage pairs a clean white navigation bar with a full-width solar-panel photograph and a large white headline. Purple accents highlight the call to action and decorative elements. The layout feels corporate and image-led, although the amount of text over the hero image makes it somewhat busy.
modernity_reasons: The full-width photographic hero and large sans-serif headline give the page a contemporary look.
A restrained white navigation bar and consistent purple accents create a recognisable visual identity.
The hero contains several lines of small text over a detailed photograph, making it feel crowded and reducing readability.

data.positioning: Solarvest presents itself as a Malaysian clean energy expert and integrated solar provider serving residential, commercial, industrial, utility and government customers across Asia-Pacific.
data.headline_message: Reliable, affordable and accessible clean energy for all.
why_choose_us: End-to-end solar services, from consultation and design through installation, monitoring and maintenance.
Experience with residential, commercial and utility-scale projects, tailored to customer needs and Malaysian conditions.
Flexible solar financing options intended to make clean energy more accessible.
Operations and maintenance, warranties and after-sales support.
Trained installers, stated certifications and the use of Tier 1 inverters and high-efficiency solar panels.
Project development, engineering, procurement, construction and commissioning expertise for large-scale solar.
A broader clean energy offering, including energy efficiency, renewable energy certificates, battery storage and EV charging.
Promised energy cost savings, system reliability and progress toward sustainability goals.
data.selling_approach: Solarvest sells primarily on end-to-end service, technical expertise, project scale and trust, supported by project examples, customer testimonials and claims about its market position. It emphasizes long-term energy savings and accessible financing rather than publishing prices, while also appealing to customers’ sustainability and net-zero goals. Prospects are directed to service pages and invited to submit an inquiry or contact the company.
proof_used: The homepage claims more than 3,900 MW of ongoing and completed projects across eight Asia-Pacific countries; the about page also cites a portfolio exceeding 2,000 MW.
The homepage claims over 14 years of expertise and more than 1,000,000 solar panels installed in ongoing and completed projects.
The company says it was established in 2012 and is listed on Bursa Malaysia’s Main Market.
The large-scale solar page claims over 600 MW of LSSPV projects developed and says Solarvest was first to achieve commercial operation under Malaysia’s first LSS programme.
The site claims ISO recognition and certification by SEDA, ISPQ and GCPV, and displays accreditation and award names.
The portfolio lists projects including Micron at 8.8 MWp, Setia Kawan at 45 MWp and Classic Solar at 75 MWp.
Testimonials are attributed to Asia Meranti, Teo Seng, Nibong Tebal Paper Mill and WD Solar.
The footer claims service to more than 1,000 companies across 30 industries.
data.tone: Confident, promotional and sustainability-focused, with an emphasis on reliability and technical expertise.
target_customers: Utility-scale solar developers and project owners
Organisations pursuing renewable energy, ESG and RE100 goals
Businesses seeking EV charging, energy efficiency or renewable energy certificates
key_phrases: Reliable, Affordable and Accessible Clean Energy for All

OUR MISSION
-----------

###### We accelerate the transition to clean energy, to positively impact people and the environment.

OUR VISION
----------

###### Energising a net zero world that impact lives.

WHO WE ARE
----------

### Driven by the vision to lead the reinvention of energy generation and application, progressively advancing communities, Plus Xnergy upholds the Energy Trilogy through our solutions, which consists of Energy Generation, Energy Efficiency and Energy Storage.

###### As a clean energy solutionist, we are focused on the future, your future. We redefine a cleaner and smarter new energy landscape and we make this a reality for the greater nation, community and most importantly, you.

Plus Xnergy is a Malaysian clean energy solutionist and one of the country's top solar companies, designing, building, and operating solar PV, battery energy storage systems (BESS), and energy-efficiency solutions for homes, commercial and industrial businesses, and solar farms.

The company has collectively completed **six solar farms across Malaysia**, deployed one of the nation's largest C&I self-consumption BESS projects, and is delivering the **RM71.76 million KLIA Aeropolis integrated solar PV + BESS SelCo project**. Its leadership was named **EY Emerging Entrepreneur of the Year 2019 (Malaysia)** and listed on Tatler Asia's Gen.T 2020 for engineering, manufacturing and energy.

![](https://www.plusxnergy.com/wp-content/themes/plusxnergy/img/about-us-main.jpg)

OUR LEADERS
-----------

#### Board of Directors

![](https://www.plusxnergy.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/09/people-bod-raymond-new.jpg)

###### Raymond Oh

Director

Chairman of BE International

Board of Director of AMC Board of Director of AMC Electrical Sdn Bhd

As part of the board, Oh brings his leadership experience from BE International, AMC Electrical, board of directors of Elephant Group and Tenaga Wan Foong to oversee the group’s direction and overall performance. He is also known as one of the earliest shareholders of Plus Xnergy in the early 2010s and has seen the transformational growth of the group, from an energy consultancy firm to the award-winning total clean energy solutionist it is today.
![](https://www.plusxnergy.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/08/people-bod-ko-3-edited.jpg)

###### Ko Chuan Zhen

Group Chief Executive Officer  
& Executive Director

EY Emerging Entrepreneur of The Year 2019 – Malaysia

Involved in Clean Energy Since 2007 Across 12 Countries & 20+ Cities in Asia Pacific, Africa and Middle East.

As Group CEO and co-founder, Ko Chuan Zhen sets the business’s direction and strategy,  
ensuring that they are executed with focus on satisfactory results. Combined with  
leadership, passion and in-depth knowledge in clean energy, his contributions have driven  
Plus Xnergy to become an industry leader and motivate a passionate and reliable team  
determined to achieve company’s mission and vision. Ko was awarded Ernst and Young’s  
Emerging Entrepreneur of the Year 2019 and listed by Gen. T List 2020 for the category of  
“Engineering, Manufacturing and Energy,” list by Tatler Asia that recognises 400 young  
entrepreneur leaders who are shaping Asia’s future.
![](https://www.plusxnergy.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/people-bod-poh-2.jpg)

###### Poh Tyng Huei

Executive Director

EY Emerging Entrepreneur of The Year 2019 – Malaysia

Involved in Clean Energy With Expertise in Finance & Telecommunications Since 2007

As the executive director, Poh oversees the business’s direction to ensure its success.  
Bringing his expertise in telecommunications from Digi and financial expertise from  
Maybank, Poh led, managed and developed the operations of Plus Xnergy to produce  
proven results. Formed by his leadership and inspiring dream, the company’s philosophy  
has also attracted many passionate talents to join the ranks which has since evolved into  
an excellent team. As a graduate from Multimedia University (MMU), Poh is a qualified and  
trained engineer with a degree in telecommunications engineering.
![](https://www.plusxnergy.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/08/people-bod-ryan-5-edited.jpg)

###### Ryan Oh Zhi Kang

Executive Director

EY Emerging Entrepreneur of The Year 2019 – Malaysia

MBA – New Ventures Management,  
EMYLON Business School

As the Executive Director of Plus Xnergy, Oh is the front-liner to spearhead the company’s  
smart energy solutions in order to materialise innovation that can be developed into new  
business models. With a degree in electrical engineering, Oh was employed in an  
Australian firm with dealings in research and developing advanced water treatment  
systems. Together with his team, Oh achieved a patent in water treatment processing  
method, igniting his passion for a sustainable future which he brought to Plus Xnergy and  
leads the company by prioritising strategy and innovation in line with the rapid pace of  
the energy industry.

OUR STORY
---------

LOOKING BACK AT

### OUR PAST

![](https://www.plusxnergy.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/our-story-past-1.jpg)

With the launch of Leaf Energy —through determination and ingenuity —our four-man team secured, and then made our mark on major and visionary solar projects across the country. Just like that, the landscape of Malaysian energy was fast-forwarded into a bold, new and optimistic future.

At Plus Xnergy, we create the future. We power industries and communities to achieve their fullest potential and beyond. A new world where revolutionary, future-thinking zero-carbon energy infrastructure leads the way. Our team is spirited, insightful and full of bold ideas. We are ready to make your vision a reality.

ENERGY STORAGE SOLUTIONS
========================

###### Spearhead energy independence for your organisation with energy storage.

MAXIMISE YOUR ENERGY SAVING WITH BATTERY ENERGY STORAGE SYSTEM (BESS)
---------------------------------------------------------------------

###### 

Integrating a **Battery Energy Storage System (BESS)** with your solar PV setup is the ultimate way to achieve true energy resilience and cost efficiency. While standard solar configurations require you to use electricity in real-time or export it to the grid, a dedicated battery solution captures excess daytime generation and stores it for when you need it most—during peak evening hours or unexpected grid interruptions.

Designed for residential [energy storage solutions](https://www.plusxnergy.com/solutions/energy-generation/solar-for-home/) as well as medium and high-voltage commercial and industrial facilities, a BESS gives you the power to **optimize solar generation** and build a more stable, future-proof energy strategy. For businesses, it serves as a powerful tool for **peak shaving**, allowing companies to drastically reduce peak demand and avoid heavy utility tariffs. For homeowners, it ensures your house runs cleanly on stored sunshine long after the sun goes down, further insulating your household from rising electricity rates..

AI-POWERED BATTERY SYSTEM
-------------------------

Our BESS system is driven by the AI system to monitor and manage your business operation consumption and react unexpectable load spike within seconds of ramp rate to ensure Maximum Demand (MD) remains controlled. With such, your smart battery storage system helps to avoid “peak shaving” from the high capacity and network chargers (formerly referred as Maximum Demand as a whole by TNB).

BENEFITS OF BESS SYSTEM
-----------------------

![](https://www.plusxnergy.com/wp-content/themes/plusxnergy/img/battery-storage/battery-storage-icon-1.svg)

##### **Better Use of Solar**

Avoid capping your solar generation during weekends or low-load periods. Our Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) stores surplus energy efficiently for later use - improving your **solar utilisation rate** and **reducing grid dependency**.

![](https://www.plusxnergy.com/wp-content/themes/plusxnergy/img/battery-storage/battery-storage-icon-2.svg)

##### **Emergency Backup**

Enjoy peace of mind knowing your energy storage system can provide **backup power during unexpected outages**. This **resilience feature is available as an optional upgrade**, designed for businesses that require uninterrupted operations and critical load protection.

![](https://www.plusxnergy.com/wp-content/themes/plusxnergy/img/battery-storage/battery-storage-icon-3.svg)

##### **Lower Your Energy Bill**

By storing low-cost energy and using it when needed, you will be saving on the cost of electricity offsetting peak periods with higher electricity rates.

![](https://www.plusxnergy.com/wp-content/themes/plusxnergy/img/battery-storage/battery-storage-icon-4.svg)

##### **Eligible for Tax Allowances**

By investing in clean energy, you can be eligible for the Capital Allowance (CA) & Green Investment Tax Allowance (GITA) of up to 38%.\* Learn how to apply for this when you give us a call.

![](https://www.plusxnergy.com/wp-content/themes/plusxnergy/img/battery-storage/battery-storage-icon-5.svg)

##### **Reduce Your Carbon Footprint**

Save energy for times when you need it the most. By having an energy storage system, you are enhancing the efficiency and flexibility of the grid while helping to offset carbon emissions.

data.positioning: Plus Xnergy describes itself as a Malaysian clean energy solutions provider that designs, builds and operates solar, battery storage and energy-efficiency systems for homes, businesses and solar farms.
data.headline_message: Become a champion of sustainable energy.
why_choose_us: A combination of energy generation, efficiency, storage and smart energy solutions.
Financial and environmental benefits, including lower operating costs and reduced carbon emissions.
Flexible financing for business battery storage, including outright purchase and a zero-upfront-cost model.
AI-powered battery management intended to control peak demand and improve solar use.
Optional battery backup for businesses seeking protection from outages.
Experience delivering solar farms and large commercial and industrial battery projects.
A stated commitment to delivering solar farm projects on time.
data.selling_approach: Plus Xnergy sells clean energy through a mix of cost savings, energy independence and sustainability, with separate paths for homes, businesses and solar farms. It builds trust through its claimed project track record and awards, while promoting flexible financing and repeatedly inviting visitors to contact the company.
proof_used: Claims to have collectively completed six solar farms across Malaysia.
Says it deployed one of Malaysia's largest commercial and industrial self-consumption battery storage projects.
Says it is delivering the RM71.76 million KLIA Aeropolis integrated solar PV and battery storage project.
Cites EY Emerging Entrepreneur of the Year 2019 in Malaysia and Tatler Asia's Gen.T 2020 list.
Lists a 2018 MOSHPA OSH Excellence Award gold for occupational safety and health management in solar PV engineering, procurement and construction.
Dates its story to the launch of Leaf Energy in 2012 and claims four Malaysian offices and a 200-strong workforce.
The homepage project and savings counters appear as zero in the supplied page text, so their actual totals cannot be established from it.
data.tone: Aspirational and confident, combining sustainability language with business-focused savings and resilience claims.
target_customers: Organisations considering battery storage and energy efficiency
key_phrases: Power Your Business With Clean Energy

**Trusted Solar Power Panel & Service Provider Since 2015**
===========================================================

For over a decade, Verdant Solar has helped homeowners and businesses across all of Peninsular Malaysia make the switch to reliable solar energy. As an experienced solar panel installer and solar service provider, we support customers throughout the entire journey, from system design and solar installation to commissioning, monitoring and ongoing after-sales support.

Our solar solutions are tailored to each property’s energy usage, roof conditions and long-term savings goals, helping customers reduce electricity costs while getting more value from clean energy.

### Full coverage across Peninsular Malaysia

From Perlis to Johor, our teams design, install, and maintain solar systems across every state on the peninsula (excluding remote islands), backed by three regional hubs:

#### **Selangor** *Central Hub*

#### **Penang** *Northern Hub*

#### **Johor** *Southern Hub*

Why Choose Verdant Solar?
-------------------------

Choosing the right solar company is about more than installing panels. Verdant Solar provides an end-to-end solar solution, from understanding your electricity usage and designing the right system to professional installation, commissioning and [after-sales support](https://verdantsolar.my/maintenance/).

We serve both [residential](https://verdantsolar.my/solar-pv-for-residential/) and [commercial](https://verdantsolar.my/solar-pv-for-commercial-industrial/) customers across Malaysia, with solar solutions designed for long-term performance, reliable energy generation and meaningful electricity savings.

With more than a decade of experience, thousands of completed installations and continued customer support after commissioning, Verdant Solar is here to make your transition to solar easier and more dependable.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%2092%2092'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

Sungai Buloh

There were problems with living in Malaysia for 20 years after moving from the Netherlands, which is known for its cold weather. Bangi

Kuala Lumpur

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20799%20800'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

### Tan Sing Wei

Setia Alam

Meet Mr. Tan, a man who pays only RM70 electricity bill monthly although he stays with his big family! How? Mr. Tan lives in a gorgeous 3 storey terrace with his beautiful family. He has a lift at home that makes it easier for his parents to move about. On top of that, has a nice setting near a fish pond where he spends time with his children in the evenings. It is a lovely home with helpful features but you know what that means – High electricity bills. However, Mr Tan is not burdened by the bills because he is able save up much more now that he’s using solar energy!

Shah Alam, Selangor

During the lockdown period of Malaysia, Wendy Lim’s household electricity bills began to climb as her husband were working from home and her two children were attending class online. Solar ATAP Malaysia for Landed Homes
====================================

[Learn More](#next)

What is Solar Atap
------------------

**Solar ATAP** (Solar Accelerated Transition Action Programme) is Malaysia’s rooftop solar programme introduced on 1 January 2026, following the end of the NEM 3.0 scheme. Managed by Sustainable Energy Development Authority (SEDA Malaysia / [**SEDA Portal**](https://www.seda.gov.my/reportal/atap/)) and Tenaga Nasional Berhad ([**TNB Portal**](https://www.mytnb.com.my/renewable-energy/solar-accelerated-transition-action-programme)), the programme is designed to help homeowners make better use of the solar energy they generate while allowing excess electricity to be exported back to the grid.

Save More on Your TNB Bill with Solar ATAP
------------------------------------------

If you live in a landed home and your monthly TNB bill is RM200 or more, Solar ATAP can help lower your electricity bill by using more of your own solar energy at home. With ATAP replacing NEM, system design now has a bigger impact on your savings.

**Designed for landed homeowners in Malaysia who want to see real savings.**

[Calculate My ATAP Savings](#atap-form)

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201200%20800'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

Is Your Home Suitable for Solar ATAP?
-------------------------------------

Solar ATAP works differently from older schemes. You save the most when you use solar energy directly, while excess energy is exported to offset your electricity charges. This means your savings depend on how well your system is designed around your actual usage, not just how much energy it generates.

**Most homeowners don’t realise this:**

A system that’s too big or poorly designed can generate excess energy that you don’t fully benefit from, reducing your overall savings.

**You’re a strong candidate for Solar ATAP if:**

* **You live in a Landed Home:** Rooftop solar is best suited for landed properties with full system control.
* **Your monthly TNB bill is RM300 or higher:** Higher usage means more energy you can offset directly, leading to faster savings.
* **You have available roof space:** A clear roof with minimal shading ensures better system performance and more consistent generation.

Unlike older schemes like NEM, Solar ATAP does not use fixed one-to-one credits. Your savings depend more on how much of your solar energy you use directly in your home.

[Check My ATAP Eligibility & Potential Savings](#atap-form)

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%202560%201440'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

What does Solar ATAP cost and how much can you save?
----------------------------------------------------

Most residential systems in Malaysia fall within this range:

* System size: 4kW – 10kW
* Typical home bill: RM300 – RM500/month

Example Scenario 


Payback Concept (Simple)

If your bill is around **RM400/month**:

* A properly sized solar system can offset a large portion of your electricity  usage
* Estimated savings can range between 30% to 70%, depending on usage pattern

Over time, this adds up to a significant cost reduction.

Instead of thinking about cost upfront, think in terms of:

* Monthly savings replacing part of your electricity bill
* Long-term reduction in rising energy costs

Most homeowners see their system pay for itself over time, especially with consistent usage.

Why Verdant is Your Safest Strategy for the New Solar ATAP Rules

FAQ
---

Are you interested in solar solutions but have some questions in mind unresolved? We’ve consolidated top asked questions that may help make you take the step to decide today.

### What is Solar ATAP

**Solar ATAP** (Solar Accelerated Transition Action Programme) is Malaysia’s rooftop solar programme introduced on 1 January 2026, following the end of the NEM 3.0 scheme. Managed by Sustainable Energy Development Authority (SEDA Malaysia / [**SEDA Portal**](https://www.seda.gov.my/reportal/atap/)) and Tenaga Nasional Berhad ([**TNB Portal**](https://www.mytnb.com.my/renewable-energy/solar-accelerated-transition-action-programme)), the programme is designed to help homeowners make better use of the solar energy they generate while allowing excess electricity to be exported back to the grid.

### Should I wait before installing Solar ATAP?

If your electricity bills are already high, waiting usually means continuing to pay more to TNB. Solar ATAP allows you to start reducing your bills now, especially if your home meets the basic requirements.

### Is Solar ATAP better than NEM?

Solar ATAP works differently from NEM. While NEM offered one-to-one credit, ATAP focuses more on self-consumption. With the right system design, homeowners can still achieve strong savings.

### How much can I save with Solar ATAP?

Savings depend on your electricity usage and system size. Many homeowners see **30% to 70% reduction** in their electricity bills when the system is properly designed.

### Do I need a battery for Solar ATAP?

Not necessarily. Most homes can benefit from solar without a battery.

However, a battery can provide additional benefits:

* Store excess solar energy for use later
* Reduce reliance on the grid
* Provide backup power during outages (depending on system setup)

Homes looking for greater energy independence or more control over their usage may benefit more from adding a battery.

### How long does installation take?

Once approvals are completed, installation is usually fast and can often be completed within a short timeframe, depending on your home and system size.

### What kind of homes qualify for Solar ATAP?

Solar ATAP is mainly suitable for **landed homes** with sufficient roof space and active TNB accounts with bills of RM200 or more. Apartments and condos are generally not eligible.

### How do I know what system size I need?

The right system size depends on your electricity bill, usage pattern, and roof space.. A proper assessment ensures your system is optimised for savings under Solar ATAP.

About SOLS Energy
=================

SOLS Energy is Malaysia's No. 1 home solar company, founded in 2015 and headquartered in Kuala Lumpur.

Backed by Petronas and 500 Startups, we have completed **9,517+ solar PV installations** and deployed **37.9 MW of clean energy** capacity across the country.

Through our SOLS Solar Academy and Green Impact programmes, we have also brought off-grid solar to **5,270+ Orang Asli and Orang Asal (Indigenous) homes**.

![SOLS Energy credo: People, Planet, Prosperity](/assets/images/about-us/people%20planet%20prosperity%20logo.svg)

We exist to make **green energy** a **basic human right.**
----------------------------------------------------------

Our Vision
----------

A world where green energy solutions are accessible and affordable to anyone, anywhere, for the betterment of now and our future generations.

Our Mission
-----------

To transition every home to green energy while providing energy access for homes without electricity and creating green jobs.

We Power To Empower
-------------------

### We **power** your home.

When you power your home with solar, you are not only saving on electricity bills but also creating a better, greener and more sustainable future for all.

![Impact Goals](/_next/image?url=%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fabout-us%2Fenergy-transition.jpg&w=828&q=75)

### We **empower** rural Malaysia.

SOLS Energy installs a pico solar system for an Orang Asli / Orang Asal home that has no access to electricity every time a customer chooses to install solar with us. One-for-one.

![Impact Goals](/_next/image?url=%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fabout-us%2Fenergy-acess.jpg&w=828&q=75)

### We **create** an equitable future for low-income families with a focus on the Orang Asli & Asal (Indigenous) communities.

We hire from these communities with the aim to create green jobs that transitions them from poverty to middle-class outcomes. 30% of our profits are directed to the impact programmes under SOLS Foundation.

![Impact Goals](/_next/image?url=%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fabout-us%2Fgreen-jobs.jpg&w=828&q=75)

Our Story
---------

Built with a vision by the founder of SOLS Energy, to live on a planet where clean and affordable energy is accessible to anyone, anywhere, we have always wanted to free our community from fossil fuels for the betterment of future generations and to cope with the global climate crisis.

SOLS Energy believes in being responsible to all, including our planet, so we strive to give you the best service, equipment, and pricing. We believe in win-win-win situations whereby everyone benefits and no one loses.

SOLS Energy has completed 9,517 installations across Malaysia, including over 4,247 residential homes as of October 2026, growing by 8–12 new families every day, and deploying 37.9 MW of residential solar capacity.

We have brought off-grid solar to 5,270 Orang Asli (Indigenous) homes across 180 villages, benefiting 19,539 Orang Asli villagers, and are growing by 1,500–2,000 OA homes annually, making us Malaysia's largest residential and indigenous solar PV provider by households served. Every installation is SEDA-registered under Solar ATAP, and every project creates employment for Orang Asli youth through our Solar Academy, which today makes up 56% of our 210-strong and growing workforce.

SOLS Energy was founded in 2015 and formally incorporated as SOLS Energy Sdn. Bhd. in 2017, registration no. 201701007142 (1221307-W).

Our Credo

### People. Planet. Prosperity

Growth, happiness and development mindset, with work-life balance.

Smart use of resources and zero waste.

We genuinely care about our team and those we serve.

We are all responsible for success. We only win as a team.

Our Promise
-----------

![SOLS Energy team member at work](/_next/image?url=%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fabout-us%2Femployee.jpg&w=1200&q=75)

To Our Employees
----------------

We will always invest – in your talent, growth, development and well-being. We will work hard to provide opportunities to flourish and to combine an attractive salary with meaning, purpose and a supportive work-life culture. We trust you and give you the freedom and space to make decisions and build upon your ideas. We will go through dynamic ways with you. We have your back: as a sparring partner, a mentor, a friend and an ally.

To Our Customers
----------------

We will be the green energy company that you love. We will do everything to help you make responsible and wise decisions. We promise transparency in all our processes and help you understand the complexity and benefits of sustainable energy in a convenient way. We will always be there for you and support you in every possible way to make a safe and viable investment in yourself, your family, your company, the future generation, and the planet.

To Our Partners
---------------

We will stand by your side – no matter what. We won’t simply say we cannot do it; we will find a way to make it possible. We stay fun to work with and support you as an innovative, dynamic and dedicated team. We keep on looking at the broader perspective and promise to stay true to our cause: seeing the profit and prioritising the benefits of our communities and mother earth.

[![SOLS Energy Logo](/assets/icons/energy_logo.svg)](https://www.solsenergy.com/)

The core belief of SOLS Energy is that everyone deserves better. You, our community and the planet all matter.

We are working towards that goal by providing green solutions for you, by making it convenient and stress free.

SOLS Energy has completed **9,517 installations** across Malaysia, including over **4,247 residential homes** as of October 2026, growing by 8–12 new families every day, and deploying **37.9 MW** of residential solar capacity.

Every installation is SEDA-registered under Solar ATAP, and every project creates employment for Orang Asli youth through our Solar Academy, which today makes up **56% of our 210-strong and growing workforce**. About Us
========

Samaiden is an award-winning clean energy services and solutions provider.

* [Homepage](https://samaiden.com.my/)

Welcome

Introducing Samaiden Group Berhad

Samaiden, an award winner of the ASEAN Energy Award 2017 is a Clean Energy provider incorporated in 2013, principally involved in engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning (EPCC) of solar photovoltaic (PV) systems and power plants.

[Our Journey
➔](https://samaiden.com.my/our-journey/)

[Our Journey
➔](https://samaiden.com.my/our-journey/)

![](https://samaiden.com.my/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/Environmental-Consultancy-1.jpg)

### The Cornerstone of the Clean Energy Transition

Among the world’s greatest threats, global warming and climate change have sparked a paradigm shift in all
sectors, driving the worldwide goal of carbon neutrality.
The time for change is now, with the continued
development and use of renewable energies at the centre
of the energy transition.

From solar to biomass and beyond, our commitment to
sustainable practices drives us to create an impactful,
renewable energy solution that drives us towards a
greener tomorrow.

Who We Are

### An Award-Winning Clean Energy Services & Solutions Provider

The foundation of our principal subsidiary, Samaiden Sdn
Bhd, in 2013 marked the start of what is now known as
Samaiden Group Berhad. With the increasing
environmental concern, we have stepped up our offerings
and investments in clean energies. Today, we are a clean
energy services and solutions provider, primarily involved
in the engineering, procurement, construction, and
commissioning (EPCC) of clean energy projects, including
but not limited to Solar Photovoltaic (PV) systems,
Biomass and Biogas systems, Battery Energy Storage
Systems (BESS), Mini Hydro, Waste-to-Energy solutions
and much more.

Samaiden Group Berhad is also an investment holding
company listed on Bursa Malaysia's Main Market since
year 2023.

Fuel Versatility

Zero Carbon Emissions

Export Potential

Waste Reduction

Circular Economy

Learn More About Our Government's Initiative Programmes

ATAP

ATAP

![](https://samaiden.com.my/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/fit.jpg)

The Solar Accelerated Transition Action Programme (ATAP) is a government initiative that encourages more Malaysians to adopt solar PV systems. Through this scheme, any excess energy generated can be exported back to the grid on a “one-on-one” offset basis. This means no energy goes to waste, and you can enjoy lower electricity bills when your system produces more than you consume.

SELCO

SELCO

![](https://samaiden.com.my/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/Screenshot_2021-07-15-Website-Correction-5-3-pdf.png)

The Self-Consumption (SELCO) programme is meant to help your business in minimising the overall energy consumption, particularly when your industry is required to operate 24 hours a day, seven days a week.

FIT

FIT

![](https://samaiden.com.my/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/nem.png)

Malaysia’s Feed-in Tariff (FiT) system obliges Distribution Licensees (DLs) to buy from Feed-in Approval Holders (FIAHs) the electricity produced from renewable resources and sets the FiT rate. The DLs will pay for renewable energy supplied to the electricity grid for a specific duration.

Our Journey
===========

Founded in 2013, Samaiden Group Berhad has grown from a renewable energy startup to a key player in solar PV and clean energy solutions, culminating in its 2020 listing on Bursa Malaysia.

* [Homepage](https://samaiden.com.my/)
* Our Journey

![](https://samaiden.com.my/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Our-Journey-2.webp)

We dream big and fast

We are a group of devoted, creative, and imaginative people that are passionate about bringing the benefits of renewable energy to the community. We work together in a fun and efficient manner.

Ever since 2013 when Samaiden Sdn Bhd established, our co-founders, and directors are driven by the aim of improving people’s electricity consumption patterns through the Energy Trilogy, which comprises Energy Security, Energy Affordability, and Energy Sustainability. The parent organization of Samaiden Group is now a Public Listed company in Bursa Malaysia.

We are continually innovating what we do, embracing every chance and obstacle, and striving to adapt and improve in order to give this world a better and greener future.

Publishes testimonials praising responsive staff, professional project implementation and patient sales explanations.

Top Earthing & Lightning Protection & Solar PV Solutions Provider in Malaysia
=============================================================================

At Pekat, we are a solar PV supplier that specialises in supplying high-quality solar photovoltaic systems in Malaysia, and also provide earth termination system and surge protection system (earthing & lightning protection) solutions across various projects. 

We have made it our goal to supply the best systems solutions, which has led us to being one of the most successful earthing & lightning, and solar PV system suppliers in Malaysia. 

We work with you to understand your needs and provide a solution that meets them. From initial design through installation, we’re committed to quality and customer satisfaction.

###### OUR SOLUTIONS

###### Earthing & Lightning Protection

During an unintended electrical events, such as a short circuit, power surge or lightning strike, the unintended electricity will flow from the power source through the earth continuity conductors into the earth lead and then into the earth electrode, where it is dissipated into the earth

[Know More](/solution/earthing-lightning-solutions/)

###### OUR SOLUTIONS

###### Solar PV

We offer a comprehensive Solar Photovoltaic one-stop solution, with the objective of helping our customers to prioritise and manage energy costs through a strategic energy management system.

[Know More](/solution/solar-photovoltaic-pv-solutions/)

[RESIDENTIAL](https://pekat.com.my/solution/solar-photovoltaic-pv-solutions/solaroo/)

Why Should You Install  A Solar PV System In Malaysia?
------------------------------------------------------

* **Lower Your Monthly Electricity Bills**

You probably already know that the price of energy is on the rise, so it is financially beneficial to generate your own power and avoid paying growing rates.

* **Minimise Your Carbon Emissions**

Solar energy is a clean and renewable source of energy that will help reduce your carbon footprint by minimising greenhouse gas emissions.

* **Low Maintenance Cost**

A solar PV system has no moving parts, so after the initial investment, there would be minimal costs for maintenance and repairs.

Why choose us
-------------

### Experience

Over 24 years of engineering experience

### Quality

Provide highest quality and value-added solar PV and earthing & lightning protection solutions

### Reliable

Reliable international solution partners such as Furse, Sungrow, Longi, Trina Solar and more

### After-sales service

Superior after-sales service & warranties on all our products

###### Get In Touch With The Top Earthing & Lightning and Solar PV Company in Malaysia

Pekat’s services are available throughout Malaysia, so if you’re in need of a reliable solar PV system supplier or a specialist in earthing & lightning protection solutions, simply [contact us](https://pekat.com.my/contact-us/) now!

About Us
========

[Home](https://pekat.com.my "Go to Pekat Group.") / About Us

Our Story
---------

Established in 1999, Pekat Group Berhad has built its reputation as a competent solution provider specialising in the design, supply, distribution, and installation of lightning protection systems, earthing systems, surge protection systems, and other related technologies.

In 2006, the company grew and started to work with Photovoltaic (PV) Renewable Energy Technology. Since then, we have become one of the first choices of solar PV companies in Malaysia.

As the most popular solar company in Selangor and Kuala Lumpur, we are committed to giving our customers long-term value and making sure that the costs invested are a viable alternative to paying high electricity bills through our solar PV systems.

Since we started, we have finished more than 218MWp of prestigious and significant PV projects for homes, private companies, developers, and companies with ties to the government. This has made us one of the nation’s most trusted and preferred solar PV providers companies in Selangor and Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.

We also work with well-known companies to make a wide range of products that meet international standards. This has helped the company build up the necessary skills, experience, and knowledge needed to be the leader in this niche market.

modernity_reasons: The full-width photographic hero and large typography create a contemporary first impression.
The bright gradient call-to-action button provides a clear visual focal point.
The desktop navigation wraps Contact Us onto a second line, making the header look less polished.

content_volume.summary: The sitemap lists 145 addresses. The site covers solutions, products, project references, news, blogs, sustainability, investor relations and company information.

data.positioning: Pekat presents itself as a Malaysian solar PV and electrical protection solutions provider serving homes, private companies, developers and government-linked companies.
data.headline_message: A “comprehensive Solar Photovoltaic one-stop solution” to help customers manage energy costs.
why_choose_us: Over 24 years of engineering experience.
High-quality, value-added solar PV and earthing and lightning protection solutions.
International solution partners including Furse, Sungrow, Longi and Trina Solar.
After-sales service and warranties on all products.
Support from initial design through installation, tailored to customers’ needs.
Solar benefits presented as lower electricity bills, reduced carbon emissions and low maintenance costs.
data.selling_approach: Pekat sells through a one-stop, needs-based service proposition, emphasising engineering experience, quality, partner brands and after-sales support. It builds trust with project capacity figures, awards and customer testimonials, while appealing to buyers’ desire to reduce electricity costs and carbon emissions. Visitors are directed to solution and product details or invited to make an enquiry; the supplied pages do not show prices.
proof_used: Established in 1999 and working with photovoltaic technology since 2006.
Claims to have completed more than 218 MWp of PV projects.
Names international partners including Furse, Sungrow, Longi and Trina Solar.
Publishes testimonials attributed to Damansara City Mall, KIP REIT and PERSADA PLUS.
Lists Furse Master Distributor of the Year for 2011–2013 and an SME100 award.
Cites Malaysia Book of Records recognition as the first photovoltaic installer to receive ISO 50001:2011.
Provides project reference categories for on-grid, off-grid and hybrid solar PV.
Says Pekat Group Berhad was listed on Bursa Malaysia’s ACE Market in 2021.
calls_to_action: Read More or Know More about solutions.
Contact Us or send an enquiry.
data.tone: Professional, confident and reassuring, with a practical focus on savings, quality and experience.
target_customers: Customers seeking earthing, lightning and surge protection

What is NET ZERO and Why is It So Important in Malaysia
=======================================================

![Writer: Progressture Solar]()

Progressture Solar

Oct 4, 2022

6 min read

As the world is being confronted with various environmental catastrophes associated with climate change, the term net zero has become one of the most important concepts in global discussions. Governments and industries around the world are being urged to drastically reduce their greenhouse gas (GHGs) emissions and take steps to achieve net zero by 2050 in response to the 26th United Nations Conference on Climate Change [(COP26)](https://www.un.org/en/un-climate-change-conference-cop-26). In Malaysia, the commitment is shown in many ways, including offering schemes and incentives to encourage renewable energy adoption. Other countries are also making significant efforts by exploring remarkable pathways to cut carbon emissions.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/e4f25b_7f0ad9fb219d4d539120c30ea0c098ba~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_980,h_430,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_avif,quality_auto/e4f25b_7f0ad9fb219d4d539120c30ea0c098ba~mv2.jpg)

In fact, the [2015 Paris Agreement](https://www.un.org/en/climatechange/paris-agreement) recorded over 190 countries including Malaysia pledge to limit the rise in global average temperatures to 1.5°C and mitigates the effects of climate change. This pledge has mounted pressure on governments and companies, prompting them to take action. Investors are now not only demanding forward-looking disclosures but also expecting credible plans for how major companies manage and reduce their emissions. Ultimately, achieving net zero emissions by 2050 is a global goal that must be understood before targeting and strategizing efforts toward achieving it.

#### What is Net Zero?

The concept of Net Zero refers to the goal of reducing emission levels as close to zero as possible and offsetting the emissions that cannot be removed to prevent the addition of GHGs to the atmosphere. Put simply, net zero is a state where the number of emissions emitted to the atmosphere is equal to the number of emissions being removed. Among all GHGs, carbon dioxide is the most prevalent gas which accounted for [77%](https://cla.auburn.edu/ces/climate/global-gas-emissions/) of global gas emissions. The rise of carbon dioxide emissions into the atmosphere is majorly contributed by human activities such as burning fossil fuels that come from natural gas, land-use change, and deforestation. Conversely, the removal of carbon can be performed by environmental processes such as carbon capture and sequestration which revolve around the elimination of carbon from the atmosphere. The term net zero emission is also often used interchangeably with the terms carbon neutrality and net zero carbon footprint, which both refer to an effort of balancing the emissions.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/e4f25b_4d01ffdfaf474bb984b0b5842d485d1d~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_147,h_82,al_c,q_80,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,blur_2,enc_avif,quality_auto/e4f25b_4d01ffdfaf474bb984b0b5842d485d1d~mv2.jpg)

#### How Can Net Zero Carbon Emissions Be Achieved**?**

Achieving net zero carbon emissions requires the adoption of low-carbon emission pathways. This may include the deployment of clean energy to replace fossil fuels, reducing total energy consumption as well as increasing energy efficiency. Energy-dense liquid fuels made from hydrogen and ammonia, biofuels, synthetic hydrocarbons, and direct solar fuels may be critical to supplying the energy required to operate stationary and mobile energy production sectors. Further, to achieve the target by 2050, policy orientations must shift at all levels, where technological development is adapted to international climate goals, and changes in corporate and consumer behavior are fully emphasized. In general, the goal can be achieved through these two prime strategies:

##### Carbon Reduction

As its name suggests, this effort involved the reduction of carbon emissions by adjusting industrial, agricultural, and other processes. One major way to do this is by adopting renewable energy sources (e.g., solar and wind energy) and improving energy performance. While both fossil fuel and non-fossil fuel-based energy sources produce emissions, non-fossil fuel-based energy sources are infinite and produce much lower emissions compared to coal and natural gas. In fact, according to [Climate Action](https://www.climateaction.org/news/renewables_can_reduce_co2_emission_by_70_by_2050), renewable energy could significantly reduce carbon emissions by over 70% by 2050.

##### Carbon Removal

Alternatively, carbon removal refers to the process of removing carbon from the atmosphere and storing it elsewhere. This can be done either naturally or artificially, for instance, forests, which are known as carbon sinks that are able to store carbon, can absorb a net of [7.6 billion](https://gfmc.online/2021/09-2021/africas-remaining-forests-are-under-pressure-this-is-no-time-to-sideline-forest-carbon-markets.html) metric tons of CO2 per year. Unlike some strategies for cooling the climate and mitigating global warming, this strategy does not require costly and complex technological arrangements to capture and store carbon, making it a key strategy in the fight against climate change.

#### Why Net Zero is Important and What Will Happen if it is Not Achieved by 2050?

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/e4f25b_96fda94dcd9d4d0ebfb5e9e593b9adf7~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_147,h_93,al_c,q_80,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,blur_2,enc_avif,quality_auto/e4f25b_96fda94dcd9d4d0ebfb5e9e593b9adf7~mv2.jpg)

Net zero emission has become the latest buzzword in climate action ever since serious environmental problems are happening around the globe. As global warming occurs at an alarming rate, extreme weather events linked to climate change like floods and heat waves are hitting humans and other species much harder than before. If we are to prevent global temperatures from rising more than 2°C above pre-industrial levels as pledged in the 2015 Paris Agreement, then the net zero goal is imperative to be achieved. Without the net zero emissions target, there will be no urge to reduce emissions globally and the amount of carbon being released into the environment will continue to escalate. The result of this is that a greater number of greenhouse gases will be continuously trapped in the atmosphere, accelerating the effects of climate change as the Earth heats up.

* ![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/e4f25b_5d787d23fe664ed89bb1bcf3f306471b~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_1920,h_1281,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/e4f25b_5d787d23fe664ed89bb1bcf3f306471b~mv2.jpg)
* ![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/e4f25b_cc938c22261443b6b6e113f6793ab6bd~mv2.jpeg/v1/fill/w_1920,h_1215,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/e4f25b_cc938c22261443b6b6e113f6793ab6bd~mv2.jpeg)
* ![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/e4f25b_56b9245d71764f12bc5e12010f1122ba~mv2.jpeg/v1/fill/w_1920,h_1278,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/e4f25b_56b9245d71764f12bc5e12010f1122ba~mv2.jpeg)

As the largest threat to our world today, climate change is indeed one of the most pressing issues facing humanity. It is a global problem that has profound consequences for the environment and human safety. When the planet gets warmer, the sea levels rise, and more extreme weather events occur. Scientists believe that this situation is likely to cause ever-worsening extreme weather and potentially catastrophic sea level rise, resulting in the inability to live in some parts of the globe and fueling hunger and migration around the world. This, along with growing public pressure, is the reason why a growing number of countries, companies, and others are pledging to cut their emissions to zero by 2050 or before. Fundamentally, the potential impact of climate change on the environment and the future of our planet would be immense and irreversible, and for this reason, everyone should be committed to working towards this goal.

#### How to Achieve Net Zero Carbon Emissions?

The world has become aware that carbon emissions need to be significantly reduced if the climate is to be kept within safe limits. To achieve the net zero carbon emissions goal, everyone plays a crucial role. At the government level, it is critical that policymakers work together to find solutions that address both local and global challenges. These may include acting on energy efficiency, implementing carbon pricing, regulating the energy and transport sectors, increasing clean energy generation, promoting green businesses, and reducing emissions from land use, among others.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/e4f25b_2985b8d29f654fc6bc57b1b3e5baff01~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_147,h_87,al_c,q_80,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,blur_2,enc_avif,quality_auto/e4f25b_2985b8d29f654fc6bc57b1b3e5baff01~mv2.jpg)

Meanwhile, companies and businesses play a vital role by making fundamental transformations in their value chains, business models, and governance structures. Efforts must be made to reduce emissions through sustainable solutions including the transition to clean energy and adhering to ESG standards. As individuals and society, everyone can significantly contribute to achieving net zero by reducing their carbon footprint through sustainable practices and being advocates for a greener future.

#### Achieving Net Zero with Renewable Energy

* ![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/e4f25b_1ac09329f11f495fafee6dc7bf5fcbf0~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_1251,h_2084,al_c,q_90,enc_auto/e4f25b_1ac09329f11f495fafee6dc7bf5fcbf0~mv2.jpg)
* ![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/e4f25b_bdc935f7e1584c88957ad547e9fce3df~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_1251,h_1779,al_c,q_90,enc_auto/e4f25b_bdc935f7e1584c88957ad547e9fce3df~mv2.jpg)
* ![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/e4f25b_bcf14a155b144f68b3e51bfdfd921ad1~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_1251,h_1779,al_c,q_90,enc_auto/e4f25b_bcf14a155b144f68b3e51bfdfd921ad1~mv2.jpg)

As countries around the world adopt policies and practices to reduce emissions, renewable energy plays an increasingly significant role in helping to meet net zero and climate goals. Indeed, the transition toward green energy and a low-carbon economy calls for the integration of renewable energy sources such as solar power more strongly into the grid to replace higher-carbon sources like coal and gas. Through the adoption of renewable energy, consumers will continue to have access to affordable and sustainable electricity in the near future while contributing to a greener world. Realizing that the goal of net zero emissions is a journey that needs to be supported together, a mature strategy and planning need to be prepared for the development of renewable energy.

#### The Bottomline

Climate change is already evident, and if carbon emissions are not significantly reduced and mitigated, the effects are only going to get worse. While the country has made commitments since the 2015 Paris Agreement, there has been a lot of progress towards achieving the net-zero Malaysia target. However, there is still a lot of work that needs to be done to reach the goal by 2050. To achieve the target, necessary breakthroughs will be needed in many areas. This includes developing alternative energy sources, improving energy efficiency, reducing the use of fossil fuels, and promoting carbon pricing. That said, the transition to a low-carbon economy will require the development of innovative technologies and processes supported by clean energy. From a climate perspective, the most crucial factor is that everyone is working together to reduce carbon emissions at every level. In doing so, more emissions can be prevented from entering the atmosphere and the future can be safeguarded against the dire consequences of climate change.

data.positioning: Progressture Solar presents itself as a clean energy provider and net-zero partner offering end-to-end solar and battery storage solutions for Malaysian homes, businesses and large-scale energy projects.
data.headline_message: Your Partner for Net-Zero Solar Solutions.
why_choose_us: End-to-end service from feasibility and financing through engineering, construction, commissioning, monitoring and maintenance.
Solar and battery storage expertise, including electricity tariffs, incentives, safety and long-term system performance.
Flexible ownership through outright purchase or a zero-upfront-capital power purchase agreement for companies.
Potential electricity bill savings, tax benefits and protection against rising tariffs.
Support for emissions reduction, net-zero targets and ESG goals.
A safety-focused, process-driven approach with stated commitments to timelines and quality.
Experience with different rooftop structures and ground-mounted systems.
Ongoing performance monitoring, maintenance and all-risk insurance.
Products sourced from recognised global and local suppliers.
data.selling_approach: The company sells a tailored, consultative service rather than a standard-priced product, offering a free quote, consultation and electricity-bill ROI assessment. It combines cost-saving and zero-upfront-investment claims with net-zero messaging, while using registrations, partner brands and project examples to build trust. It also stresses engineering expertise, safe delivery and long-term support.
proof_used: The company states that it is a Registered Photovoltaic Service Provider and Registered Solar Photovoltaic Investor, and holds a CIDB Malaysia G7 licence.
The portfolio lists projects by capacity and location, including 3.25 MWp in Masai, Johor and 1.84 MWp in Shah Alam, Selangor.
Named portfolio examples include Mapei Malaysia and Lim Tayar.
The home page displays partner brands including Trina Solar, Astronergy, JJ-Lapp, Huawei, Sungrow, Jinko Solar and Solis.
The home page claims savings of up to 85% on monthly electricity bills and a reduction in taxable income of up to 38% in the first year; these are company claims, not independently verified results.
calls_to_action: Get a free quote for your project
Find out how much you can save with an ROI assessment
data.tone: Confident, professional and optimistic, combining technical and financial language with climate-action messaging.
target_customers: Commercial and industrial businesses, including factory owners
key_phrases: Your Partner for Net-Zero Solar Solutions
Complete Solar Solutions for All Needs

About Us
--------

From trusted foundations to smarter energy solutions
====================================================

[](https://yellowgreen-curlew-571127.hostingersite.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/07231.mp4)

Built on Expertise.
Evolved for the Future.
-------------------------------------------

Welcome to Solaroo, part of the esteemed Pekat Group Berhad. Building on the Group’s strong solar C&I foundation since 2006, Solaroo was established to bring trusted solar PV solutions closer to homes and small businesses.

Over time, we have grown to bridge key gaps in the energy ecosystem, evolving into a holistic clean energy provider. Today, Solaroo offers comprehensive solar solutions across residential, small C&I and property developments as well as, off-grid systems, battery energy storage and EV charging.

Backed by Pekat’s decades of engineering expertise, we have powered over 7,000 properties and continue to deliver a seamless, end-to-end journey – empowering our customers to embrace smarter, safer and more sustainable energy.

Track Records that Matters

Pekat Group’s awards and recognitions reflect a long-standing commitment to quality, safety, and innovation – principles that guide every Solaroo project.

### Frequently Asked Questions

Your top questions about going solar, answered.

Who is Solaroo?

Solaroo is a wholly owned subsidiary of Pekat Group Berhad, listed on Bursa Malaysia, with over 27 years of engineering expertise in solar and lightning protection.

Are Solaroo PV systems safe?

Yes. Safety is our top priority. Every Solaroo PV system is designed and installed to high engineering standards, with no shortcuts or compromises. We use quality components, including our own Pekat surge protection device (SPD), together with approved MCBs and ELCBs, to help protect your home and ensure your solar system operates safely and reliably for years to come.

Will my solar generation be the same every month?

No. Generation depends on sunlight and weather conditions. Savings also vary based on your electricity usage. Our proposals are based on average annual estimates.

Can I install more solar panels in the future?

Yes. Our modular microinverter system allows you to expand later, subject to roof space and usage needs.

Can I move my solar PV system if I relocate?

It is recommended to sell the existing solar PV system together with the house, as it adds value to the property. While relocation is possible, it can be complex and may involve dismantling risks or potential material damage. Relocation also incurs additional costs for removal, reinstallation, and testing.

What if my roof leaks after installation?

Leakage is rare as checks are done before installation. If any damage is caused by our installation and within the defect liability period, we will repair it.

Will solar work during a blackout?

No. For safety reasons, a standard grid-connected solar PV system will automatically shut down during a power outage. To keep selected appliances running, you’ll need an Essential Power Supply (ESP) with a battery storage system.

Do I need a battery?

Under Solar ATAP in Malaysia, a battery is optional but helps maximise savings. Without a battery, excess solar energy is still exported to TNB, but it only offsets the energy charge within the same month. A battery offers higher savings by storing daytime energy for night.

Is my roof suitable for solar?

Most roofs that are in good condition are suitable. Our team will conduct a site assessment to confirm structural compatibility before any installation.

![Homepage banner image.](/media/h1anoekr/1-aug-banners-05.jpg?rxy=0.462,0&width=1510&height=450&quality=100&v=133855324213930000&format=webp)

* Gas and Related Services

As an established player with 13.3GW of gas-fired and diesel-fired power capacity across Singapore, Australia, China, Bangladesh, Myanmar, Oman, UAE and the UK, we provide reliable energy supply to industries and communities, ensuring quality of life and supporting economic development.

To bridge the gap between the current and gradual transition to clean energy, we are investing in technology and innovation to explore cleaner fuel alternatives and improve the efficiency of our plants.

### Gas-fired plants

#### 

We have proven capabilities in developing and operating gas-fired power plants with technology for greater efficiency and lower emissions, including combined cycle gas turbines, as well as cogeneration and desalination solutions. Our portfolio spans a diversified international footprint, supporting reliable and efficient energy supply across markets.

### Gas import and retail

#### 

As one of the largest players in Singapore’s natural gas market and the country’s first commercial importer and retailer of piped natural gas, we offer a wide range of solutions in gas sourcing, importation and trading. In addition, we are an importer of LNG (liquefied natural gas) for Singapore with the competencies to provide customers access to a global portfolio of LNG sources.

design.summary: The homepage uses a corporate layout with a multi-level header, large headline and wide energy-themed hero imagery. Generous spacing and teal accents give it a clean feel, although a prominent cookie dialog obscures much of the page in the screenshot.
modernity_reasons: Large typography and wide hero imagery create a contemporary visual hierarchy.
The restrained palette and ample spacing give the page a clean corporate appearance.
The cookie dialog uses clear, differentiated controls, but covers much of the initial view.

content_volume.summary: The sitemap lists 1,208 addresses. Content spans renewable energy, gas, urban solutions, sustainability, investor information, company news and careers.

data.positioning: Sembcorp presents itself as an energy and urban solutions company enabling Asia-Pacific’s energy transition for businesses and communities.
data.headline_message: Driving Energy Transition — delivering energy security and advancing sustainability.
why_choose_us: A portfolio spanning solar, wind and energy storage, alongside gas and urban solutions.
A stated focus on reliable energy supply and energy security during the transition to lower-carbon energy.
Experience managing over 2,000 solar sites in Singapore, according to an insight article headline.
Capabilities in developing and operating gas-fired plants, gas sourcing and importing liquefied natural gas.
Use of AI-driven analytics to optimise asset performance, according to the homepage.
data.selling_approach: The site leads with energy security, sustainability and the breadth of its businesses rather than prices or product specifications. It builds credibility through capacity figures, operational claims, news and stories, and directs visitors to business pages and Contact Us. The supplied text does not show solar pricing, contract terms or a detailed solar sales process.
proof_used: A news and insights headline claims Sembcorp manages over 2,000 solar sites in Singapore.
The gas page claims 13.3GW of gas-fired and diesel-fired power capacity across eight countries.
The homepage says Sembcorp completed the acquisition of Alinta in June 2026.
A news headline names DayOne as a collaborator on energy supply solutions for data centres in Asia.
The homepage shows renewable capacity figures as images, but the numbers are not available in the supplied text.
data.tone: Corporate, confident and sustainability-focused, with an emphasis on reliability and long-term impact.
target_customers: Businesses and industries seeking energy supply or decarbonisation solutions
Communities served by energy and urban infrastructure
key_phrases: delivering energy security and advancing sustainability
a growing portfolio of renewable solutions
data.site_language: English in the supplied page text. The site also links to country-specific sites, but their languages cannot be determined from the supplied text.

Asia Pacific Region

Leading the energy transition and creating superior value for all
-----------------------------------------------------------------

Headquartered in Singapore, the APAC platform isa strong contributor to the group’s renewables capacity, **representing 20% of EDPR’s solar portfolio as of 2025.**

The region continues to serve as a growth engine for the group as we lead the energy transition in APAC, through markets with strong fundamentals for renewables.

We are 100% renewables

Ground-mounted photovoltaic (PV) systems can be installed anywhere that has sufficient open space and good sun exposure.

Floating photovoltaic (PV) systems utilize large surface areas of water bodies for the deployment of solar energy systems

[Learn more](/en/asia-pacific/singapore/what-we-do/floating-solar)

Distributed generation solar
----------------------------

A distributed generation solar system uses rooftop space for solar systems, enabling business and land owners to generate clean energy efficiently from the rooftops of their buildings

[Learn more](https://www.edp.com/en/asia-pacific/singapore/what-we-do/distributed-generation-solar)

![](/sites/default/files/image/2025-04/EDPR_storage.webp)

Energy storage system
---------------------

An energy storage system (ESS) allows the capturing of produced energy from renewable sources like solar and wind and stores them for later use, ensuring a reliable and efficient power supply.

[Learn more](https://www.edp.com/en/asia-pacific/singapore/what-we-do/energy-storage-system)

About us
--------

We choose earth by being a global leader in the energy transition, with a firm commitment with sustainability and the future of the planet.

Invested in a cleaner and smarter future
----------------------------------------

EDP is organized across Europe, North America, South America and Asia, serving nearly nine million customers in regulated and liberalized markets. Aiming to lead the global transition to renewable energy, we drive inclusive decarbonization while expanding renewable generation, networks and digital solutions to support faster electrification.

![edp 50 years imagine the next 50](/sites/default/files/styles/hero_desktop/public/image/2026-03/background-lights-lighter-campaign%201.png.webp?h=197483aa&itok=SdTd89sq)

Our energy and heart drive what comes next
------------------------------------------

50 years of bold choices and continuous innovation have shaped us. Now, 12,500+ people move that same ambition forward, building the future through passion, creativity and technology.

[Explore our legacy](/en/fifty-years-celebration)

At EDP, every part of the company counts to make a difference

Our vision and strategy are reflected not only in the way we are organized internally, but also in the values and policies that define our standards and conduct, along with the partnerships that allow us to grow better.

How is EDP contributing to the global energy transition?

EDP contributes to the global energy transition by expanding renewable energy generation, electricity networks and digital solutions that support electrification and decarbonisation. The company operates across Europe, North America, South America and Asia, serving nearly nine million customers in regulated and liberalised energy markets.

How does EDP integrate sustainability into its business?

EDP integrates sustainability into its business through its focus on renewable energy, electricity networks, electrification and decarbonisation. Its strategy combines the expansion of cleaner energy solutions with commitments and initiatives designed to support the environment, nature and communities.

What is EDP's We Choose Earth initiative?

"We Choose Earth" brings together EDP's projects and commitments related to sustainability, the planet, nature and communities. It reflects the company's approach to supporting the energy transition while promoting initiatives designed to contribute positively to people and the environment.
