FAQs

Expand all
Close all

What does EDP do in the energy sector?

EDP operates across renewable energy generation, electricity networks, energy management and solutions for clients. The company produces, manages and distributes electricity, with activities across Europe, North America, South America and Asia-Pacific.

What renewable energy sources does EDP use?

EDP's renewable energy portfolio includes solar, wind and hydropower. The company also combines different renewable technologies with solutions such as energy storage and hybridisation as part of its approach to electricity generation and the energy transition.

What types of energy solutions does EDP offer its clients?

EDP provides energy solutions designed to support clients in managing their energy use and decarbonisation. These complement the company's activities in renewable generation, electricity networks and energy management, positioning EDP as both an energy supplier and a sustainability partner to its clients.

What is the scale of EDP's energy operations in 2026?

In the first half of 2026, EDP reported 32.8 GW of total installed capacity, with renewables representing 87% of installed capacity. The company also reported more than three million electricity and gas customers and approximately 393,000 kilometres of electricity networks.

design.summary: The visible desktop layout uses a two-level header, a wide muted blue-green title area and generous spacing. The page text references solar farm and project photography further down, although the screenshot mainly shows the top of the page and a large cookie consent panel. The overall feel is clean and corporate.
modernity_reasons: A large, simply styled page title and generous spacing create a contemporary visual hierarchy.
The header combines clear navigation with a prominent search field.
The cookie panel uses rounded corners and a high-contrast action button, though it obscures much of the page.
The homepage text describes image-led service, news and project sections.

content_volume.summary: The sitemap lists 7,802 addresses across the wider EDP site, rather than just the Asia-Pacific section. Content includes renewable energy services, regional markets, projects, news, careers, investor information and sustainability reports.

data.positioning: EDP presents its Singapore-headquartered Asia-Pacific platform as a renewable energy developer, owner and operator that partners with corporate energy buyers to help them decarbonise.
data.headline_message: Leading the energy transition and creating superior value for all.
why_choose_us: It develops, builds, owns and operates projects, presenting itself as a long-term energy partner.
It offers ground-mounted, rooftop and floating solar, as well as energy storage.
It says its projects help corporate customers decarbonise and make use of available land, rooftops and water surfaces.
It presents distributed solar as a way for customers to save on energy bills and gain greater control over their energy.
It describes power purchase agreements as long-term contracts that reduce price volatility and improve predictability.
It points to regional scale, established projects and the wider EDP group's experience as evidence of its capabilities.
data.selling_approach: EDP sells through a sustainability and long-term partnership message, supported by project examples, capacity figures and named corporate customers. It promotes customised solar solutions and power purchase agreements using decarbonisation, energy savings and price predictability rather than published prices. The regional page directs visitors to learn more about individual technologies and country operations.
proof_used: More than 1.6 GWp of committed clean energy capacity across six Asia-Pacific markets.
More than 1,576 GWh of clean energy generated in the region in 2025.
A claimed share of over 30% of Singapore's installed solar portfolio.
Top Employer certification in Singapore and more than 300 employees.
Projects cited include the 44 MWp Fukushima Solar Farm and a 5 MWp offshore floating photovoltaic system.
A long-term power purchase agreement with Amazon for the Fukushima project.
EDP group claims more than 15 GW of contracted PPA capacity globally and names Google, Amazon, Microsoft, P&G and Walmart as customers.
calls_to_action: Learn more about ground-mounted solar, floating solar, distributed solar and energy storage.
See what EDP does in each Asia-Pacific market.
Learn more about EDP's client solutions.

target_customers: Businesses and landowners with rooftop space

Customers seeking energy storage and decarbonisation solutions
key_phrases: develop, build, own and operate projects
Long term agreements for clean energy
Customised solutions to serve our customers' needs

The site links to awards and partner images, but the provided text does not identify specific awards or partners.

The milestones of Energy Absolute in driving an integrated energy ecosystem, creating sustainable value for the economy, society, and the environment, while delivering a stable and sustainable clean energy future for the world.

* The Company has been selected to be included in the "Sustainability Yearbook 2024" index in the Electric Utilities Industry category, a global report organized by S&P Global. This reflects the Company's management in accordance with ESG principles, creating long-term value and building trust with investors both in Thailand and abroad. The Company is committed to advancing its business under the "Energy Absolute Energy for The Future" strategy, aiming to become a leader in clean energy innovation while also taking care of the environment.
* The Company has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with the Phuket Provincial Industry Council to support Phuket in becoming a Green Island and Low Carbon City. This initiative aims to promote the growth of the tourism industry and businesses in Phuket, making the city a green island with a low-carbon footprint and the best possible environment in every dimension. The goal is to welcome tourists from around the world. The Company is ready to collaborate with the government, private sector, and the Phuket Provincial Industry Council to support and invest in Green Logistics and Green Electricity on the island of Phuket.
* The Company has received the Thailand Top Company Award 2024 in the Energy Industry category. This award is presented to outstanding organizations with excellent performance and excellence in business, to honor those that have enhanced their business management capabilities, driving sustainable growth, which is a crucial foundation for the Thai economy
* In response to the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) accusing the Company's directors and executives, Mr. Somphote Ahunai, the Chief Executive Officer, along with Mr. Amorn Sapthaweekul, the Deputy Chief Executive Officer, have announced their resignation from their positions as directors and executives of the Company, effective from 12 July 2024, onward. This decision aims to ensure transparency and provide full opportunities for thorough investigation Subsequently, the Board of Director's meeting No. 3/2024 (Special) of Energy Absolute Public Company Limited (the "Company") held on 17 July 2024, the board resolved to approve the recruitment and appointment of a special audit consultant to examine the procurement process in the operations of the solar power projects of EA Solar Nakhon Sawan Co., Ltd. (ESN) and EA Solar Lampang Co., Ltd. (ESL) (the "Projects"), following accusations made by the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) against the former executives of the Company. The Company has engaged Grant Thornton Specialist Advisory Services Co., Ltd. as the special audit consultant ("Consultant") in August 2024. On 27 January 2025, the Board of Director's meeting acknowledged the report from the consultant, who had conducted an audit of the procurement process in the operation of the projects. The findings of the audit are summarized as follows: (1) the procurement process for the projects was carried out according to the Company's policies, procurement guidelines, and the Company's approved financial transaction documents, (2) the projects were contracted for design, procurement, and construction (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction or EPC), with the contractor being responsible for the procurement of equipment, construction, and installation of all systems, (3) the projects were financed through project financing from financial institutions, which required the appointment of a Lender Technical Advisor (LTA) to evaluate both the technical and financial aspects of the projects from the beginning. The LTA also reviewed the work each time funds were disbursed. In addition, the technical advisor from the financial institution provided opinions and reviewed the project's performance throughout every step of the project until completion, (4) the projects were executed within the approved budget set by the Company's Board of Directors, and (5) the projects achieved higher actual energy production compared to the energy production targets initially set

The Board also resolved to appoint Mr. Chatrapon Sripratum as a Director of the Company (replacing Mr. Somphote Ahunai, the resigned Director) and Executive Director.
* On 1 August 2024, the Board of Directors resolved to appoint Mr. Chatrapon Sripratum as the Chief Executive Officer and Mr. Vasu Klomkliang as the Chief Financial Officer.
* On 14 November 2024, the Board of Directors resolved to approve the change of authorized signatories for the Company as follows: "Mr. Somboon Ahunai, Mr. Vasu Klomkliang, and Mr. Chatrapon Sripratum. Any two of these three directors shall sign jointly, along with the Company's official seal."
* On 2 December 2024, the Board of Directors resolved to approve the convening of the Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders No. 1/2025 on 7 January 2025, to propose the increase of the Company's registered capital by THB 495,112,186.60, from the original registered capital of THB 371,334,140 to a new registered capital of THB 866,446,326.60. This will be done by issuing no more than 4,951,121,866 additional ordinary shares with a par value of THB 0.10 per share, to support (1) the allocation of additional ordinary shares to existing shareholders according to their shareholding ratio (Rights Offering) and (2) the exercise of rights under the warrants to purchase the ordinary shares of the company no. 1, to be allocated to existing shareholders who subscribe and are allocated the additional ordinary shares offered to existing shareholders according to their shareholding ratio (Rights Offering). The Shareholders' Meeting has approved the increase in the Company's registered capital as detailed above.

Bio Innovation Business

B100, Purified Glycerin and By-products
=======================================

The Company operates an integrated business in the production and distribution of biodiesel (B100), pure glycerin, and related by-products. The Company is also a licensed Oil Trader under Section 7 of the Fuel Trade Act B.E. 2543, granted by the Ministry of Energy.

![](/storage/our-businesses/bio-innovation-business/b100-purified-glycerin-and-by-products/b-purified-glycerin-by-products.webp)

![](/storage/element/element-green-l.svg)

“Powering economic value through progress and leading the transition to sustainable renewable energy.”

Biodiesel (B100)

We are a producer of Biodiesel (B100), a clean fuel made from vegetable oils and animal fats that can directly replace conventional diesel, reducing dependence on fossil fuels and being environmentally friendly.

![](/storage/our-businesses/bio-innovation-business/b100-purified-glycerin-and-by-products/img-1.webp)

Production capacity

liters/day

Purified Glycerine

We also produce Purified Glycerine, which is clear, safe, and odorless. It can be used across various industries, including food, pharmaceuticals, and cosmetics, as well as everyday products such as toothpaste and soap.

![](/storage/our-businesses/bio-innovation-business/b100-purified-glycerin-and-by-products/img-2.webp)

By-Products

We create additional value from by-products generated during production, including:

* Crude Glycerine: used in chemical, cosmetic, and pharmaceutical industries
* Free Fatty Acids (FFA) & Palm Fatty Acid Distillate (PFAD): previously sold externally, now recycled as raw materials for biodiesel production, reducing waste and improving resource efficiency

design.summary: The homepage uses a full-width photographic hero with a translucent navigation bar, large white headings and a floating performance card. Generous spacing and rounded controls give it a polished corporate feel, although the cookie notice covers part of the performance card.
modernity_reasons: Full-bleed photography and a transparent navigation bar create a contemporary hero section.
Large typography, ample spacing and rounded cards establish a clear visual hierarchy.
The performance card and slider indicator present business information in a compact visual format.
The cookie notice obscures some of the hero content on the desktop screenshot.

content_volume.summary: The sitemap lists 1,000 addresses. The site covers multiple energy businesses, renewable projects, corporate governance, investor information, news, careers and sustainability.

data.positioning: Energy Absolute presents itself as one of Thailand’s leading renewable energy businesses, supplying electricity to Thai utilities and offering biofuels, batteries, commercial electric vehicles and charging services.
data.headline_message: Creating sustainability, creating a livable world.
why_choose_us: Clean energy from solar and wind is presented as a way to reduce environmental impact and dependence on imported energy.
An integrated energy ecosystem spans renewable power, biofuels, batteries, electric vehicles and charging.
The company says it uses modern technology to improve production efficiency and support energy security.
EA Anywhere promotes convenient charging through a mobile app and nationwide locations.
The company emphasizes fairness and trust with partners and shareholders.
data.selling_approach: The site emphasizes sustainability, energy security, technology and the scale of its operations rather than price. It identifies EGAT and PEA as electricity customers and uses project locations, capacity figures and links to business pages to establish credibility. For biofuels, it provides contact details, a LINE link and a downloadable catalogue; no solar pricing or sales process is shown in the supplied text.
proof_used: The company reports 278 MW of solar power capacity and four commercially operational solar projects.
It names the Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand and the Provincial Electricity Authority as electricity customers.
The homepage reports 386 MW of wind capacity, excluding 180 MW in new projects under power purchase agreements.
The homepage reports EA Anywhere charging stations at 500 locations.
The company says it was included in the S&P Global Sustainability Yearbook 2024 and received the Thailand Top Company Award 2024 in the energy category.
It says it is a licensed oil trader under Thailand’s Fuel Trade Act.
data.tone: Corporate, optimistic and sustainability-focused, with an emphasis on technology and national energy security.
target_customers: Electric vehicle and energy storage markets
key_phrases: One of Thailand’s Leading Renewable Energy Businesses
Creating sustainability, creating a livable world
EA's Moving Towards Net Zero Ecosystem
data.site_language: The supplied pages are in English, with links to Thai and Chinese versions.

Informasi Teknis
================

  
  

**KONFIGURASI ON-GRID (GRID-TIED)**    
  
![on grid solar](/_ipx/_/https://storage.googleapis.com/xurya-app-files/xurya-web/On%2520Grid%2520New%2520Design%25202023%2520-%2520Shaina%2520Islamey.png)  
  

Konfigurasi on-grid diperuntukan bagi pelanggan di daerah yang
telah terjangkau PLN. Pada konfigurasi ini, sistem PLTS atap
akan berjalan paralel dengan PLN dan dengan demikian mengurangi
penggunaan listrik dari PLN. Output sistem akan disesuaikan
dengan karakteristik listrik PLN dan akan otomatis mati bila
terjadi gangguan PLN. Konfigurasi on-grid tidak dapat berfungsi
sebagai pengganti genset, kecuali apabila ditambah dengan
baterai.

**KONFIGURASI OFF-GRID**    
  
![off grid solar](/_ipx/_/https://storage.googleapis.com/xurya-app-files/xurya-web/improve%2520core%2520web%2520vitals%2520performance/rooftop-solar/Off-Grid-New-Design.png)  
  

Konfigurasi off-grid diperuntukan bagi pelanggan di daerah
terpencil. Pada konfigurasi ini, sistem PLTS dirancang untuk
menggunakan komponen yang dapat berfungsi independen, tanpa
referensi tegangan listrik dari PLN. Output sistem tetap kami
sesuaikan dengan standar nasional Indonesia agar sesuai untuk
aplikasi pelanggan.

### **MODUL SURYA / FOTOVOLTAIK**

  
Modul surya adalah komponen utama sistem PLTS yang berfungsi
untuk merubah cahaya menjadi listrik DC melalui efek
fotovoltaik. Selain hanya memakai produk dari pabrik Tier-1,
Xurya juga menerapkan standar keselamatan dan performa yang
ketat pada semua modul yang kami gunakan, termasuk SNI dan
standar IEC yang terkait.

**Partners**    
  

![logo-patner](/_ipx/_/https://storage.googleapis.com/xurya-app-files/xurya-web/rooftop-solar/PV/seraphim%252Blogo.jpg)

![logo-patner](/_ipx/_/https://storage.googleapis.com/xurya-app-files/xurya-web/rooftop-solar/PV/canadian-solar-logo.png)

![logo-patner](/_ipx/_/https://storage.googleapis.com/xurya-app-files/xurya-web/assets/atap/longi.png)

![logo-patner](/_ipx/_/https://storage.googleapis.com/xurya-app-files/xurya-web/rooftop-solar/PV/Jinko_logo-1-768x386.png)

![logo-patner](/_ipx/_/https://storage.googleapis.com/xurya-app-files/xurya-web/assets/atap/JA%2520Solar%2520-%2520Shaina%2520Islamey.png)

### **INVERTER**

  
Fungsi utama inverter PLTS adalah merubah arus DC dari modul
menjadi arus AC agar dapat dikonsumsi. Xurya menerapkan standar
keselamatan dan performa yang ketat pada semua inverter kami,
termasuk SNI, standar IEC yang terkait, dan peraturan PLN. Demi
kenyamanan anda, kami hanya memilih inverter modern yang secara
otomatis menyesuaikan output dengan PLN, dan otomatis mati bila
ada gangguan jaringan.

**Partners**    
  

![logo-patner](/_ipx/_/https://storage.googleapis.com/xurya-app-files/xurya-web/assets/atap/sungrow.jpeg)

![logo-patner](/_ipx/_/https://storage.googleapis.com/xurya-app-files/xurya-web/assets/atap/huawei-logo.png)

### **IOT & SISTEM MONITORING**

  
Bagi pelanggan yang ingin memantau kinerja sistem mereka
secara real-time, Xurya bekerja sama dengan Solar-Log(TM) dari
Jerman untuk melengkapi seluruh sistem kami dengan IoT dan
sistem monitoring berbasis web.

**Partners :**    
  

![logo-patner](/_ipx/_/https://storage.googleapis.com/xurya-app-files/xurya-web/assets/atap/lufft.png)

![logo-patner](/_ipx/_/https://storage.googleapis.com/xurya-app-files/xurya-web/rooftop-solar/IOT%2520%2526%2520Sistem%2520Konfigurasi/Solar-Log_Logo_300px_us.png)

![logo-patner](/_ipx/_/https://storage.googleapis.com/xurya-app-files/xurya-web/assets/atap/kippzonen.png)

### **MOUNTING & INSTALASI**

  
Instalasi yang baik dimulai dari kualitas SDM yang mumpuni.
Untuk itu, kami bekerja sama dengan rekan-rekan EPC solar yang
telah terbukti keterampilannya. Metode pemasangan akan
tergantung dari atap anda demi mengurangi resiko bocor: kami
memakai ballasted mounting pada atap dak, kaki-L pada atap
zincalum bermur, dan kaki cliplock pada atap zincalum
spandeck.

Below it, a spacious white section introduces services through a row of darkened photographic tiles. The overall feel is clean and corporate, with orange accents and bold, straightforward typography.

modernity_reasons: The full-width photographic hero and prominent rounded call-to-action give the page a contemporary layout.
Large headings, clear navigation and generous white space make the page easy to scan.
The darkened image tiles and conventional corporate layout feel functional rather than especially distinctive.

data.positioning: Xurya describes itself as a leading Indonesian solar developer providing complete solar energy services to commercial and industrial building owners across Indonesia.
data.headline_message: Complete solutions for solar energy needs.
why_choose_us: A complete service covering financing options, engineering design, installation, operation and maintenance.
A no-upfront-cost option.
On-grid and off-grid solar configurations, with web-based monitoring for real-time system performance.
Tier-1 solar modules and equipment selected against stated safety and performance standards.
Installation methods adapted to the roof type to reduce leakage risk, with experienced solar EPC partners.
Experience serving commercial and industrial customers across Indonesia.
A stated commitment to positive social and environmental impact.
data.selling_approach: Xurya sells an end-to-end service, emphasizing ease of transition and a no-upfront-cost option rather than publishing prices in the supplied pages. It builds confidence through project counts, certifications, technical standards, equipment and installation partners, awards and environmental benefits. Visitors are encouraged to simulate their contribution or contact the sales team.
proof_used: Claims more than 150 solar projects in Indonesia and the trust of hundreds of commercial and industrial building owners.
States it has been trusted by industry leaders in Indonesia for more than six years.
Lists ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018 certifications, as well as B Corp certification.
Lists the 2024 Kehati ESG Award, Forbes Asia 100 to Watch 2023, a G20 Digital Innovation Network 2022 award and a Huawei Indonesia Best C&I Project Award.
Describes a social responsibility project providing greener electricity in Komodo National Park with investor East Ventures.
Displays equipment and technology partners, including Canadian Solar, LONGi, Jinko, Sungrow, Huawei and Solar-Log.
Homepage contribution figures are shown as loading, so their values are not visible in the supplied text.
target_customers: Customers in grid-connected and remote areas seeking solar configurations

TENTANG SUN ENERGY
==================

Mitra Strategis dalam Transformasi Energi dan Keberlanjutan
-----------------------------------------------------------

SUN Energy adalah solar project developer untuk sektor industri dan komersial (C&I) di Indonesia, Singapura, Vietnam, Australia, Taiwan, dan Thailand. Berdiri sejak 2016, SUN Energy telah menyelesaikan 400+ proyek PLTS dengan total kapasitas 450 MW di Asia-Pasifik.
SUN Energy menawarkan solusi terintegrasi mulai dari pengembangan sistem energi surya, pengelolaan energi, hingga pembiayaan berkelanjutan untuk membantu bisnis Anda mencapai target dekarbonisasi.

SOLUSI KAMI

Berbagai Tipe Sistem PLTS
-------------------------

* On Grid
* Off Grid
* Hybrid

![](https://sunenergy.id/cfind/source/images/icon-ongrid.svg)

**On Grid**
Maksimalkan daya yang dihasilkan matahari pada siang hari dan manfaatkan listrik yang disediakan oleh jaringan listrik nasional pada malam hari.

![](https://sunenergy.id/cfind/source/images/icon-offgrid.svg)

**Off Grid**
Dapatkan listrik bertenaga surya secara mandiri, dengan atau tanpa baterai.

![](https://sunenergy.id/cfind/source/images/icon-hybrid.svg)

**Hybrid**
Daya sistem energi surya digabungkan dengan sumber energi lain, seperti genset diesel, gas, angin, dan lain-lain.

Profil Perusahaan

![](https://sunenergy.id/images/material/bg-top.svg)

![](https://sunenergy.id/cfind/source/thumb/images/about/cover_w990_h480_tw1080_th523_x10_y118_di-1_.png)

Berdiri sejak tahun 2016, SUN Energy telah mengokohkan posisinya sebagai pengembang energi surya sektor komersial dan industrial di Indonesia, dan telah memperluas kehadirannya ke lima negara. SUN Energy melayani ekosistem energi hijau yang komprehensif, menyediakan solusi energi surya yang disesuaikan dan terintegrasi untuk beragam pelanggan.

SUN Energy terus berkembang dengan stabil melalui dukungan para pelanggan dan mitranya. Perusahaan telah mampu berekspansi ke pasar-pasar baru sambil terus menyediakan solusi energi surya yang dapat diandalkan untuk industri di Indonesia.

![](https://sunenergy.id/cfind/source/thumb/images/cover_w66_h66_icon-vision.png)

### Visi

SUN Energy memiliki visi untuk mempromosikan energi yang berkelanjutan, rendah emisi, dan transisi menuju energi terbarukan dengan menerapkan sistem energi surya untuk sektor komersial dan industri. Dengan mendukung upaya pemerintah untuk mencapai target bauran energi nasional, kami bertujuan untuk memberikan kontribusi terhadap masa depan yang lebih hijau untuk semua.

![](https://sunenergy.id/cfind/source/thumb/images/cover_w66_h66_icon-mission.png)

### Misi

* Secara aktif menciptakan solusi revolusioner yang mendukung masa depan berkelanjutan bagi banyak orang
* Memberikan solusi dengan menawarkan gaya hidup yang ramah lingkungan untuk semua orang

![](https://sunenergy.id/images/content/bg-businessmodel.jpg)

##### TENTANG KAMI

Mengapa SUN Energy

![](https://sunenergy.id/images/material/bg-top.svg)

### **Mengapa SUN Energy**

SUN Energy adalah penyedia solusi keberlanjutan terintegrasi dari Indonesia. Beroperasi di 5 negara; Indonesia, Singapura, Australia, Thailand, dan Vietnam, kami membangun ekosistem keberlanjutan untuk mendorong transisi menuju masa depan rendah karbon.

![](https://sunenergy.id/cfind/source/thumb/images/about/cover_w990_h480_tw1069_th518_x111_y1123_iqb_0231-copy_.png)

Kami berkomitmen untuk menghadirkan layanan Sustainability-as-a-Service yang membantu bisnis mengurangi ketergantungan pada bahan bakar fosil, menekan emisi karbon, dan mengoptimalkan efisiensi energi. Visi kami adalah menciptakan masyarakat yang dapat menikmati manfaat energi terbarukan dan praktik bisnis berkelanjutan tanpa kompromi.

Melalui kemitraan strategis dengan berbagai perusahaan teknologi energi global, SUN Energy telah mengembangkan portofolio proyek energi bersih yang luas di seluruh Asia-Pasifik.

Kami adalah tim ahli teknik, perancang, dan inovator keberlanjutan yang berkomitmen menghadirkan solusi energi cerdas dan ramah lingkungan, memberikan listrik hemat biaya bagi semua orang sambil melindungi planet yang kita tinggali bersama.

##### Menjadi SUN Partner

Bergabunglah dengan Kami sebagai Mitra dan Tumbuh Bersama
---------------------------------------------------------

![](https://sunenergy.id/images/material/bg-top.svg)

Gabung jadi mitra kami untuk mewujudkan Indonesia yang lebih berkelanjutan
--------------------------------------------------------------------------

![](https://sunenergy.id/cfind/source/thumb/images/cover_w990_h480_banner-about.jpg)

Indonesia memiliki potensi untuk menghasilkan sekitar 640.000 Terrawatt-hour (TWh) per tahun dari energi surya. Bersama SUN Energy, Indonesia dapat memberikan kontribusi besar untuk mengurangi krisis iklim.

SUN Energy berkomitmen untuk membangun masyarakat yang lebih berkelanjutan dengan pemasangan sistem energi surya. Kami menyediakan produk yang terjangkau, berkualitas tinggi, dan inovatif di seluruh Indonesia. Misi kami juga termasuk mengedukasi pelajar melalui program energi terbarukan dan memasang sistem energi surya di daerah pedesaan dan terpencil untuk menyediakan akses listrik.

Sumber energi konvensional yang banyak digunakan saat ini berasal dari energi fosil yang dapat habis dalam beberapa tahun ke depan.

Jadi, mari kita tumbuh bersama untuk menciptakan dunia yang lebih baik di masa depan.

Solar infrastructurefor industry.
=================================

Design, supply, construction, commissioning and maintenance of solar PV for commercial, industrial, public-sector and developer clients across Peninsular Malaysia.

[Request a site assessment](#contact)[Company profile 2026 (PDF)](/docs/eternalgy-corporate-profile-2026.pdf)

Three years. Twelve megawatts.
------------------------------

12**MWp+** of solar PV installed and commissioned

1,100**+** sites commissioned across Peninsular Malaysia

60**+** commercial and industrial projects completed

35**RM million+** in customer revenue since 2023

G7**CIDB grade**, the highest, with no limit on tender value

Capabilities
------------

### Engineering and construction

* Solar EPCC
* Duo Mix systems
* Battery storage and off-grid
* Electrical works
* SEDA and TNB approvals

Solar EPCC, Duo Mix systems, battery storage and off-grid, electrical works, and SEDA and TNB approvals.

### Financing and schemes

* Zero-capex solar: PPA and leasing
* Maybank solar financing
* GITA: 60% solar, 100% storage
* ATAP and SELCO
* CRESS and CREAM

Zero-capex PPA and leasing, Maybank financing, GITA allowances, and advice on ATAP, SELCO, CRESS and CREAM.

### Operations

* eSAJ monitoring
* Six-monthly inspection
* Thermal drone scanning
* 48-hour fault response
* EV charging
* Software and IoT engineering

eSAJ monitoring, six-monthly inspection, thermal drone scanning, 48-hour fault response, EV charging, and in-house software.

Select a capability for the scope we deliver.

Your bill after solar, simulated.
---------------------------------

Most solar quotes multiply your bill by a saving percentage. The Eternalgy Solar Simulator, built in-house by our software team, rebuilds your TNB bill from the tariff, follows every kilowatt-hour your system generates, and calculates the bill you will pay after solar, item by item. For homes and for businesses.

* **Your bill** The amount and month on your TNB bill.
* **Tariff match** The usage that produces that bill, with that month's surcharge.
* **System size** Panels sized to your usage at Malaysian sun-peak hours.
* **Energy flow** Used on site, exported, or beyond the credit cap.
* **New bill** Every component recalculated at your new usage.
* **Your saving** Old bill minus new bill, plus the export credit.

[Send us your bill](https://wa.me/601121000099?text=Hi%20Eternalgy%2C%20please%20simulate%20my%20TNB%20bill%20after%20solar.)[How the simulator works (PDF)](/docs/eternalgy-corporate-profile-2026.pdf#page=5)

Home · RM500 bill, April 2026, three-phase

RM361.58

saved a month · RM504.67 → RM143.09 · 10.4 kWp, 16 × 650 W panels

Business · RM5,000 bill, low-voltage commercial, open daily 8 am–6 pm

RM2,387.14

saved a month · RM4,999.68 → RM2,612.54 · 45.5 kWp, 70 × 650 W panels

Worked examples from the Eternalgy Solar Simulator, TNB tariff in force October 2026. A simulation cannot know weather, shading, changes in usage or future tariffs; we confirm it with a site survey and, ideally, up to twelve months of bills before you commit.

From consultation to long-term output

![Engineering drawings on a desk](/images/b2b/step-design.webp)

Share your electricity bill. We simulate your bill after solar and recommend the scheme that fits.

A clear proposal with milestone-based payments, financing options and GITA incentives.

![Engineer inspecting string inverters](/images/b2b/step-commissioning.webp)

### Approvals

![Crane lifting solar modules onto a factory roof](/images/b2b/step-construction.webp)

Certified crews with site supervision. Most C&I rooftops take 4 to 8 weeks from survey to commissioning.

eSAJ real-time data, inspection every six months and thermal drone scans, backed by our hotline.

Company Profile & EPC Services
==============================

Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) credentials, SEDA RPVSP/RPVI investor status, and corporate setup nationwide.

Eternalgy Sdn Bhd
=================

**Eternalgy Sdn Bhd** (Reg No: 202301029164 / 1523087-A) is a premier Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) firm and SEDA Registered PV Investor (RPVI) specializing in utility-scale and commercial rooftop solar PV installations in Malaysia.

Incorporated on **31 July 2023** in Johor Bahru, Eternalgy designs, supplies, builds, commissions and maintains solar PV for commercial, industrial, public-sector, developer and residential clients, using **JinkoSolar Tiger Neo 3.0** modules and **SAJ** inverters and storage.

Our Engineering Team

Our own certified engineering team designs, installs and supports every system, including Solar Design Engineer Ahmad Safwan bin Ahmad Nazri (SEDA GCPV certified designer, ST Competent Energy Manager) and Solar O&M Engineer Ahmad Faruoqi bin Ibrahim (ST Competent PW4, SEDA GCPV wireman and chargeman). One team, one point of accountability.

data.summary: Most readable sites present solar as a route to lower energy costs and sustainability, supported by project experience and an invitation to enquire. Eternalgy stands out for its dark, technical homepage hero, named engineering team and detailed long-term service promises. Its assisted bill simulation is a useful sales tool, but several competitors offer a self-service calculator. Malaysian sites range from homeowner-focused quote journeys to corporate clean-energy and investor websites, while the sampled neighbouring-country sites more often emphasise industrial customers, regional scale or energy infrastructure. Many sites have extensive sitemaps, although address counts do not necessarily represent distinct content pages and are not directly comparable across different business scopes. GSPARX returned a timeout, Cypark displayed an empty directory, and SPCG's main-site design was not visible, limiting those comparisons. All project totals, savings and other performance figures cited here are company claims rather than independently verified results.
design_findings: Full-width photography or video, large headlines, generous spacing and prominent calls to action are common across the readable sites. Corporate white-and-green or dark technology-led palettes recur.

Eternalgy's visible hero is the most highly rated for modernity in the supplied assessments, at 9 out of 10. Its restrained dark palette and oversized type give it a more industrial, technical character than the friendly family imagery of Verdant or the bright illustrated style of SOLS Energy.

Verdant, SOLS Energy, Samaiden, Progressture, Sembcorp, EDP, Energy Absolute and SUN Energy were assessed as modern at 8 out of 10. These are visual judgements based on the supplied views, not measures of usability or business performance.

Some initial views have visible friction: Plus Xnergy's promotion and the Sembcorp, EDP and Energy Absolute cookie panels obscure content; Pekat's navigation wraps; Solaroo's hero text appears clipped; and Solarvest's hero copy is crowded.

SPCG's screenshot shows only a commemorative entrance page, not its main-site design. GSPARX's design cannot be assessed, and Cypark's supplied view is an unbranded directory rather than a company homepage.
content_findings: Most readable company sites have substantial content spanning services, projects, company credentials and news or educational material. Larger corporate sites also devote space to investor relations, governance and sustainability.
Eternalgy's sitemap lists 986 addresses and its content includes engineering notes, projects, team members, credentials and products. The number of distinct pages is not verified.

Among Malaysian competitors with counts, Plus Xnergy lists 276 addresses, while the other substantive competitors range from 88 to 145. A larger sitemap alone does not establish better content, greater depth or stronger search performance.

Neighbouring-country counts include 1,208 addresses for Sembcorp, 1,000 for Energy Absolute, 640 for SUN Energy and 167 for Xurya. EDP's 7,802 addresses cover the wider group site, not just Asia-Pacific, so they should not be compared directly with a regional or solar-only site.

Homeowner-oriented Verdant, SOLS Energy and Solaroo explain savings, residential projects and support. Corporate and industrial sites place more emphasis on project capacities, financing, technical capabilities and investor material.
GSPARX's content volume is unknown. Cypark's visible directory contains no company content, and SPCG's overall content volume cannot be reliably established from the supplied information.
function_findings: Contact or enquiry routes, service and project navigation, articles and social links are common on substantive sites. Several Malaysian sites also make WhatsApp visible or identify it as a contact route.
Eternalgy uses WhatsApp for site assessments and bill-based simulations. Its simulation is assisted: the supplied page describes worked examples but does not show a self-service calculator.

SOLS Energy, Xurya and SUN Energy show calculator entry points, while Solaroo links to a savings calculation resource. Verdant also uses calculation and personalised recommendation calls to action, although the supplied evidence does not establish how those flows work.
Customer login or portal links are less common but appear at Plus Xnergy, Xurya and SUN Energy. Solaroo promotes an app, while Verdant describes an app for generation and performance monitoring.

Language controls are visible on several neighbouring-country sites, including Energy Absolute, EDP, Xurya and SUN Energy. Eternalgy's supplied text is English; the supplied evidence does not establish additional site languages.

Newsletter signup, referral programmes, downloadable documents and appointment features appear on selected sites rather than consistently. Reported functions whose interfaces were not visible should not be assumed to have been tested.
marketing_findings: Lower electricity bills, sustainability, end-to-end delivery and ongoing support are recurring promises. Most sites invite a tailored enquiry rather than displaying a system price.

Financing is a frequent way to address upfront cost: examples include Eternalgy's stated zero-capex PPA and leasing options, Solarvest's financing pages, Verdant's payment options, and Xurya's and SUN Energy's no-upfront-cost offers.

Eternalgy differentiates its message with one accountable engineering team, bill simulations, named engineers, inspection and response commitments, and specific warranties. Solaroo makes quote transparency central, while Verdant emphasises residential ease and speed.
SOLS Energy combines savings with a social-impact promise; Progressture emphasises net-zero partnership and ROI; and Plus Xnergy promotes storage, efficiency and resilience alongside solar.

Common proof includes project counts and capacities, named customers, certifications, awards, equipment partners and testimonials. Eternalgy also provides worked bill examples with caveats and named team qualifications.

Some claims need care when compared: Verdant's supplied pages give different homes-powered totals, Solarvest cites different portfolio capacities, and some Plus Xnergy and Xurya counters did not reveal usable values. Figures may refer to different measures or dates and should not be treated as directly comparable.
data.home_vs_neighbours: In this sample, Malaysian sites include several direct homeowner sales journeys, with free quotes, WhatsApp contact, bill savings, installation support and financing prominently described. The Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia sample more often presents corporate energy infrastructure, commercial and industrial solar, regional operations or investor information, although SPCG also markets residential rooftops and the categories overlap. Xurya and SUN Energy provide useful industrial lead-generation examples through calculator links and no-upfront-cost messaging; Sembcorp and EDP place greater weight on corporate scale and the energy transition. Visible multilingual navigation is more common in the supplied neighbouring-country examples, but this small selection does not establish a country-wide pattern.

standouts.why: Its visible hero combines a distinctive technical identity with a clear assessment action, while its named engineers, service commitments and worked bill simulations make the engineering proposition concrete.
It combines a visible bill-based savings calculator and free power study with a distinctive social-impact story and customer evidence.
It offers a focused homeowner proposition, with a detailed quote form, installation-speed claims, payment options and residential customer stories.
Its 'what we quote is what you pay' proposition makes quote transparency a clear point of difference, supported by an app and named projects.
Its industrial proposition connects flexible financing, a calculator entry point, a quote route and project-scale claims.
It clearly presents a long-term developer-owner-operator role, supported by regional project examples and corporate power purchase agreements.

gaps_and_opportunities: Offer a clearly labelled self-service bill estimate before requiring contact, then let visitors send their result to an engineer. A few competitors already have calculators, so the opportunity is to make the assumptions, limitations and next step especially clear.

Explain indicative pricing or a transparent quote breakdown where commercially practical. Most supplied sites sell through tailored enquiries rather than published system prices; Solaroo's all-inclusive quote promise is a useful benchmark.
Standardise proof with a date, definition and scope for each metric, and reconcile totals across pages. This would make project and installation claims easier to trust and compare.

Put warranty terms, response times, exclusions and the maintenance process in a concise comparison-friendly format; several sites promise support, but the supplied summaries rarely show this level of detail.
Create distinct homeowner, business and developer enquiry paths, each with relevant examples and financing explanations, rather than making every visitor interpret a broad corporate offer.

Consider tested Malay and Chinese content or assistance for Malaysian prospects. Language selectors appear on some regional sites, but the supplied evidence does not establish a multilingual Malaysian benchmark.
data.own_site_vs_competitors: Eternalgy is ahead on the supplied visual assessment of its homepage hero and is unusually specific about engineering accountability, named staff, maintenance activities, fault response and warranties. It is broadly level with established competitors in offering end-to-end delivery, financing, project proof, credentials and a direct enquiry route; its sitemap is extensive, although distinct page counts and content quality have not been verified. It is behind competitors such as SOLS Energy, Xurya and SUN Energy on visible self-service calculator access: its bill simulation requires a WhatsApp exchange. The most important improvements are to add an optional self-service estimate with clear assumptions, make the assessment and quote process easy to understand before contact, and keep dated project metrics consistent and clearly defined. The screenshot shows only Eternalgy's hero, so the visual quality and usability of the rest of its site cannot be ranked.
data.conclusion: Eternalgy already has a credible position built around engineering ownership and long-term accountability rather than generic solar savings alone. Its strongest opportunity is to pair that technical credibility with a more immediate, transparent customer journey, especially an optional self-service estimate and a clear explanation of what happens after enquiry. Consistent, dated proof and concise service and warranty terms would make its claims easier to assess. Any implementation priorities should be validated through testing, since the supplied material does not show conversion performance or the full usability of the sites.
